name: Merge Dataset
description: Shallow-merges fields into an existing (single-row/object-shaped) dataset, leaving other fields untouched. Used for: clearing related fields on lookup clear, copying a grid row into an edit dataset, recomputing dependent fields on change.

data.description: Partial object of fields to merge. Values may be literals or binding expressions, e.g. "[this.ACOPNDET_DOC_FYCODE]" to copy from the current row context.
